newsitem.title: USA: Woman, 86, spends night in dark U.S. bank vault.
newsitem.headline: Woman, 86, spends night in dark U.S. bank vault.

text.p: An 86-year-old woman who stopped by the bank to check her safety deposit box ended up spending a night in the vault when employees forgot about her.
Doris Willis of Tacoma entered the vault at the downtown branch of Washington Mutual Bank shortly before 4 p.m. and was still there at 6 p.m. when a security guard locked the facility.
Police, who had been contacted by a worried neighbour, were preparing to mobilise a search team when guards reopened the vault Thursday at 9 a.m. and Willis was discovered sitting in a chair.
"It was darker than Hades in there," Willis told local radio. "I finally found the phone, but I didn't know how to work the darn phone they had there."
She said her biggest concern during the night had been that her nephew would be concerned about her safety.

Bank spokesman Bill Ehrlich said the phone Willis used connected to an operations centre that was closed by the time she attempted to call out. He said the vault, in a remote section of the bank branch, had numerous corridors and a room that was not checked by the guard.
"In the future the entire facility is going to be visually checked before the door is locked," Ehrlich said. "We're just extremely happy that she's OK."
